triples.tail_surface: prepared to accept and live with defects and sub-standard equipment
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 接受缺陷及不达标设备
triples.evidence_text: The defective bilge pump and alarm in the aft store, the ad-hoc wiring for the operation of the engine space bilge pump, the leaking deck hatches, the out of date flares, the un-serviced liferaft and lifejackets, and the inoperative autopilot, indicate that both Speedwell’s owner and skipper were prepared to accept and live with defects and sub-standard equipment regardless of the resulting detrimental impact on vessel and crew safety.
